title: WHICH CULTURAL LENS DO MODELS ADOPT? ON CULTURAL POSITIONING BIAS AND AGENTIC MITIGATION IN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate culturally situated interview scripts across 10 different cultures (using countries as proxies) and evaluating the outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify whether the interviewer's tone adopts an 'insider' or 'outsider' perspective, quantified via metrics like Cultural Externality Percentage (CEP) and Cultural Alignment Gap (CAG).
